name: left-directional-drawer

frames.best_why: Frame 4 shows the panel fully open with avatar, file field and save button beside the portrait; frame 3 is mid-slide.
frames.render_note: Crop cuts the drawer's left edge, truncating the heading to "...te Profile Image".

tagline: A pencil on a portrait opens a slide-in panel to swap the photo.
summary: A profile-picture editor that slides in from the left when you tap the pencil over a portrait. It offers an initials placeholder, a file picker and a save button.
appearance: A portrait photo with a small dark pencil button at its corner; the drawer that slides over it is a dark left panel with an X, a truncated heading and helper line, a rounded square placeholder marked JP, a file input row and a white Save Changes button.
behaviour: Tapping the pencil slides the panel in from the left over the dimmed photo; the X or a click outside closes it. The form offers a file field and a Save Changes button.
demo_content: A woman's portrait on a teal wall and initials "JP"
search_phrases: change profile picture from a side panel
edit avatar in a sliding form
upload a new headshot in a drawer
slide over form with file chooser
edit my photo without leaving the page
avatar update sheet with save button
use_when: A profile picture needs replacing in place from the page that shows it.
avoid_when: The chosen file never updates the preview; the JP placeholder is hardcoded.
customise: No props: the portrait URL, initials, copy and file field are written in the file; only the shared drawer takes direction.
weight_why: One panel, one photo and a file input; a tap scale is the only motion.

a11y.note: The X has no accessible name and the "Profile Picture" label is not tied to the file input.

issues: The chosen file never changes the JP avatar, so the preview is fake.
The crop cuts the panel's left edge and the heading is truncated.
polish_why: Neat slide-over profile editor; static placeholder avatar and clipped crop hold it at ordinary.
title: Left Directional Drawer
